items.title: Verify software supply chain security using AWS Nitro cryptographic verification
items.summary: This post demonstrates how to use Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instance attestation to produce cryptographically verifiable Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) for your DevSecOps platform and pipeline—the software factory that builds and delivers your workloads.
items.creator: Cheyenne Lopez

items.title: Building a RAG architecture on Amazon Bedrock to support CJIS compliance
